llm_response.reason: The website fits multiple scam characteristics: it advertises extraordinarily low prices and aggressive discounts; claims a huge inventory (over 12 million items) and sells an unrealistic variety of unrelated products; uses a suspicious and uncommon TLD ('.qpon'); provides company and contact information (including an email under a mismatched, suspect domain) that does not correspond to a real, verifiable company; and uses urgency and sales pressure tactics typical of scam sites. There is no evidence of the company's existence at the listed address via external searches. These factors combined indicate it is a Fake Online Shopping scam.
